items.title: Emile Christian and Anthony Sbarbaro Interview, 1959-02-11
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...the tailor uh Raymond? He tell me he just died. No uh. [INTERVIEWEE] I don't know his name.

ctx.x: Raymond Lopez, Christian. Yeah. They mentioned La Rocca. He couldn't even blow his goddamn nose.
And then they had Manuel. Well, Perez was a Mexican. What about Merritt? Mello. What about Merritt?
